48.name: Enlarge
48.why: Enlarge: "Magic range increased by 1 panel" -- unconditional

176.name: Chicken Heart
176.source: MV increased by 3, stats decreased by 30%.
176.why: Chicken Heart: "MV increased by 3, stats decreased by 30%" -- a move row and a potency row. The text says "stats", so the potency row names all eight; if D4 means the six combat stats the row is edited, the runtime is not the limit

229.name: Evasive Maneuvers
229.source: MV increased by 3 when HP is under 25%.
229.why: Evasive Maneuvers: "MV increased by 3 when HP is under 25%" -- one effect, hp_below

341.name: Violent Courage
341.source: Attack power increased by number of enemy units on map x 3%.
341.why: Violent Courage: "Attack power increased by # of enemy units on map x 3%" -- per=map_enemy

809.name: Stone Wall
809.why: Stone Wall: "Increase DEF/RES by 30%, MV -2" -- a potency row (two stats) and a move row

842.name: Adjacent Catapult
842.source: Move range increased by 1 x the # of adjacent ally units.
842.why: Adjacent Catapult: "Move range increased by 1 x # of adjacent ally units" -- per=adjacent_ally

180.name: Rapid Move
180.source: MV increased by 2 when SP is at max.
180.why: Rapid Move: needs "SP is at maximum", which is not a condition kind

337.name: Accel Shot
337.source: Attack power increased by range (panels) x 5%.
337.why: Accel Shot: power + distance(panels) x 5% -- no per=distance scale and no distance measure

344.name: Calm Waters
344.source: Attack power increased by 30% when attacking single target.
344.why: Calm Waters: power +30% on a single target -- target_count needs an action context the pass lacks

407.name: Magic Bundle
407.source: Special skill power increased by 30%, but 50% more SP used.
407.why: Magic Bundle: skill power +30% *and* 50% more SP -- the SP-cost family still does not exist

413.name: Law by Range
413.source: Magic range increased by 2, but 50% more SP used.
413.why: Law by Range: magic range +2 *and* 50% more SP -- the SP-cost family still does not exist

464.name: Sky High
464.why: Sky High: changes movement type to flying, which is the existing `flight` predicate, not a range

692.name: Accel Element
692.source: Increase the power of an elemental ATK by 10% x moved panels.
692.why: Accel Element: elemental ATK +10% x panels moved -- needs a distance measure and an element context

829.name: Flying Bullets
829.source: Attack range is limitless when gun is equipped.
829.why: Flying Bullets: "limitless" range with a gun -- a sentinel, not an amount the game adds

862.name: All Range +
862.source: Adjacent allies' attacks and magic gain 2 more panels in range.
862.why: All Range +: an aura that raises allies' range -- the aura rows act on dealt/taken/hit/crit only

867.name: Transportation
867.source: Allows you to transport allies to the Base Panel.
867.why: Transportation: carry/transport rule, not a move-range amount

41.name: Fist Range UP
41.source: Attack range increased by 1 panel(s) when fist is equipped.
41.why: Fist Range UP: +1 panel with a fist -- needs a verified equipped-weapon category id

44.name: Bow Range UP
44.source: Attack range increased by 1 panel(s) when bow is equipped.
44.why: Bow Range UP: +1 panel with a bow -- needs a verified equipped-weapon category id

100.name: Passiveness
100.text: Increase Attack and Defense Power by %d％ and always counter when defending．
100.why: Passiveness: "Increase Attack and Defense Power by 50% and always counter when defending" -- a power row, a defense_power row and the counter predicate, three rows for one id

430.name: Demon Experiments
430.text: Within 3 panels， allies deal %d％ more damage， and enemies take %d％ more．
430.why: Demon Experiments: "within 3 panels allies deal 10% more damage and enemies take 10% more" -- a dealt aura row and a taken aura row, each naming its own relation

2012.name: Corrupting Body
2012.text: Decrease non-elemental damage taken by %d％． Inflict deprave．
2012.why: Corrupting Body: "Decrease non-elemental damage taken by 30%. Inflict deprave." -- the taken half is a row (taken -30, element 0), but "inflict deprave" is not a chance percentage: the game rolls a status it already has, and no family *adds* a status to an attack. Not counted

2090.name: Stone Statue
2090.text: As long as unit doesn't move， increase Defense Power by %d％．
2090.why: Stone Statue: defence power +% "as long as the unit has not moved" -- no did-not-move condition

2111.name: Great Wall
2111.text: Increase Defense Power by %d％， but all attacks will hit．
2111.why: Great Wall: defence power +% but all attacks hit -- no forced-hit rule

630.name: T．O． Despair
630.text: At the end of the turn destroy the Base Panel， and heal %d％ HP and SP．
630.why: T.O. Despair: regen for the heal half, but destroying the Base Panel is a battle-setup action

d4_resistance: resistance and resistance-aura rows (5) need a resistance accumulator, which is not built
